name: Vitest Testing
rationale: Vitest coverage should prove behavior near changed modules so generated work does not rely on vague manual inspection or oversized untested implementation files.

fileRules.name: Vitest Test Policy
fileRules.rule: Large implementation files need nearby behavior tests instead of only manual verification.
fileRules.trigger: A source file is large and is not itself a test file.
fileRules.recommendation: Add or update a focused Vitest test for the changed behavior.
fileRules.goodExample: src/domain/pricing.ts changes are covered by tests/pricing.test.ts.
fileRules.badExample: A large feature module is changed with no behavior test or verification command.

detectors.description: Flags large source files that should have explicit test coverage.

moduleBoundaries: Tests should exercise public behavior instead of implementation internals where possible.
testingExpectations: Run npm test or the repo's Vitest command after behavior changes.
agentInstructions: Do not claim completion for changed behavior without a fresh test or clearly stated skipped check.
